content: dhat crate (0.3.x) provides a global allocator wrapper that tracks heap allocations. HeapStats struct exposes total_bytes (total allocated), max_bytes (peak heap, i.e. global peak when curr_bytes peaked), total_blocks, max_blocks. Usage: annotate with #[global_allocator] static ALLOC: dhat::Alloc = dhat::Alloc; then in test create dhat::Profiler::new_heap(), run code, call HeapStats::get() to assert on max_bytes. This works on all platforms including stable Rust, unlike heaptrack/massif. Suitable for peak-memory assertion tests rather than full profiling. For WASM, dhat cannot be used (allocator ABI differs); use wasm-bindgen's memory APIs or measure .wasm binary size instead.
